$description: PETAL Insights design tokens. Format follows the W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft specification.

primary.$description: Primary background. Near-black with faint blue-black undertone.
Primary warm gold. Section labels, mono tags, vessel mid-state, accent borders.

contrast.$description: Cream-gold for peak emphasis states. Use sparingly at one or two points per composition.

alert.$description: Muted clinical red. Used ONLY for alert states. One per composition.

primary.$description: Primary text. Off-white, never pure white.

glow-accent.$description: Gold corner glow for background atmosphere. Apply via radial gradient.

glow-alert.$description: Red corner glow for alert-context backgrounds. Use 0.04 opacity for non-alert compositions.

callout-bg.$description: Background fill for key insight callout cards.

callout-alert-bg.$description: Background fill for alert callout cards (diagnostic moments, final stages).

one-red-per-composition.$description: The clinical red is reserved for the single critical alert moment per composition. Multiple red elements dilute the signal.

gold-as-workhorse.$description: Gold (--accent) is the primary identity color. Section tags, mono labels, vessel highlights, accent borders, decorative line work all use gold.

cream-for-revelation.$description: Cream-white (--contrast) is reserved for the moment of revelation — peak contrast states. Should appear at one or two points only.

no-saturation.$description: No saturated colors anywhere. No pure red, pure blue, pure green. The palette lives in a narrow tonal range. Sophistication comes from restraint.

layered-backgrounds.$description: Backgrounds are always layered: gradient base + subtle corner accent glows. Never use flat pure black.
